svg.title: Foreign Threats to Elizabeth I in 1558–60: France, Scotland and Catholic Europe
svg.desc: Sixteenth-century GIS historical atlas map of the British Isles and Western Europe showing Catholic encirclement of Elizabeth I upon her accession in 1558: the Franco-Scottish Auld Alliance pincer, French sea supply link over the North Sea to Leith, loss of Calais (January 1558), Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis (April 1559), Treaty of Edinburgh (July 1560), and Philip II's Spain and Spanish Netherlands centred on Antwerp.
